desc:
Welcome to Tang County, an open-world driving experience that is a 1:1 size replica of the real place located in Baoding Prefecture, Hebei Province, China. You can drive, explore, work, make new friends, and roleplay together in this game.

This game is developed by a small team, there will be bugs and areas of imperfection. If you enjoy the game, don't forget to give it a like! Thank you for your support.

This game is created as a realistic showcase in dedication to my hometown.

Update Change: Update Finale 10/1/2025

-57 new vehicles (new paint material, improved light controls, added exhaust smoke)
-Map improvements, refurbished road next to dealership & intersection
-New re-designed UI
-Improved in-game economy
-Improved textures for road signs
-E to enter vehicle

Redeem code: "UPDATEFINALE" for ¥500,000 of in-game currency

Thank you for playing!
